coordinateSystem: Pixels in the final trimmed WebP; guides are measured artwork safe areas, not CSS layout requirements

nineSlice.notes: Use one uniform corner scale for all four border-image-width values. Repeat the vertical spine rather than stretch its round rivets. Text padding must be mapped to the chosen border scale, not left as these full-image percentages after nine-slicing.

control-disc.notes: The trimmed art was only padded to a square. Use equal width and height and contain; no independent axis scaling.
